findings.cause: Operational task is routed through article research
findings.evidence: Current queue selection in ops/remote-operator.mjs selects measurement-and-operator-review (priority99) with zero sourceSeeds; discoverResearch therefore searches for official government guidance to an internal operational question. Recent remote runs report empty research.
The selector excludes only published, retired and blocked. source-access-recheck with status reviewed remains eligible and outranks all prior article topics (priority95).
isPrimarySourceUrl('https://www.cyber.gov.au/threats/types-threats/phishing') returned false; current allowlist recognizes .gov and .gov.uk but not Australian .gov.au.

findings.cause: Relevant implementation is hidden from remote model writes
findings.evidence: ops/remote-operator.mjs and engine/remote-operator-lib.mjs are protected mutation targets. This is an intentional safety boundary; remote model cannot repair its own selector directly.

findings.evidence: collectFiles stops at first file exceeding cumulative32000 characters. State and engine files precede articles; prior remote run explicitly reported missing schema. This is a separate candidate cause, not yet tested with a measured packet.
